breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities. The original request had both inlets flowing in the +x direction. The agent corrected this by setting the fuel inlet velocity to '+0.1 m/s in the +x direction' and the air inlet velocity to '-0.1 m/s in the -x direction', which correctly models the opposing jets.
